checks.name: cuopt-gpu
command:
set -euo pipefail
container_name=veoveo-cuopt-2608-test
if docker ps -a --filter "name=^/${container_name}$" --format "{{.ID}}" | grep -q .; then
  echo "refusing to replace existing container ${container_name}" >&2
  exit 1
fi
test_dir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/veoveo-cuopt-2608-test.XXXXXX)
case "${test_dir}" in /tmp/veoveo-cuopt-2608-test.*) ;; *) echo "unexpected temp directory ${test_dir}" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
cleanup() {
  docker stop --time 10 "${container_name}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  if [ -d "${test_dir}" ] && [ ! -L "${test_dir}" ]; then find "${test_dir}" -xdev -depth -delete; fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT
docker run --detach --rm --name "${container_name}" --gpus device=0 --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" --volume "${test_dir}:/run/veoveo-cuopt" veoveo/cuopt-executor:0.1.0 >/dev/null
for _ in $(seq 1 180); do
  if [ -S "${test_dir}/executor.sock" ]; then break; fi
  if ! docker ps --filter "name=^/${container_name}$" --format "{{.ID}}" | grep -q .; then docker logs "${container_name}" >&2 || true; exit 1; fi
  sleep 1
done
if [ ! -S "${test_dir}/executor.sock" ]; then docker logs "${container_name}" >&2 || true; exit 1; fi
VEOVEO_CUOPT_TEST_SOCKET="${test_dir}/executor.sock" cargo test -p veoveo-optimization-mcp --test cuopt_gpu -- --ignored --nocapture
